intro: This unit is about returning faulty goods and complaining politely. Grammar: (1) 突然 “suddenly / sudden”; (2) 即便……也/还是…… “even if…”; (3) ……得住 / ……不住 (can / can't hold, last or stand); (4) 要不然 “otherwise”. Answers marked “model answer” were written for this sheet.

key_sentences.en: (The desk lamp) suddenly broke last night.

key_sentences.zh: 即便换了新的，还是用不住。
key_sentences.py: Jíbiàn huànle xīn de, háishi yòng bu zhù.
key_sentences.en: Even if I get a new one, it still won't last.

key_sentences.zh: 我们超市的产品质量是有保证的，要不然我们也不敢承诺七天之内无条件退换。
key_sentences.py: Wǒmen chāoshì de chǎnpǐn zhìliàng shì yǒu bǎozhèng de, yàobùrán wǒmen yě bù gǎn chéngnuò qī tiān zhī nèi wú tiáojiàn tuìhuàn.
key_sentences.en: The quality of our supermarket's products is guaranteed — otherwise we wouldn't dare promise unconditional returns within seven days.

key_sentences.zh: 对我们给您带来的不便，我感到很抱歉。
key_sentences.py: Duì wǒmen gěi nín dàilai de búbiàn, wǒ gǎndào hěn bàoqiàn.
key_sentences.en: I'm very sorry for the inconvenience we've caused you.

body.zh: “突然”，形容词，表示发生得很急促，忽然。例如：
body.en: The adjective “突然” means something happened very quickly or suddenly, e.g.,
Suddenly it started pouring with rain.

body.zh: 这件事让他觉得很突然。
body.py: Zhè jiàn shì ràng tā juéde hěn tūrán.
body.en: This came as a real surprise to him.
突然 works as an adverb before a verb (突然坏了 “suddenly broke”) and as an adjective (很突然 “very sudden”) — unlike 忽然, which is only an adverb.

body.zh: 连词“即便”意思是“即使”，表示假设的让步。即承认某种事实，暂让一步，在正句里常用“也”或“还是”呼应，说出结论。例如：
body.en: The conjunction “即便” means “即使” (even if) — a hypothetical concession: you grant something for the sake of argument, and the main clause, usually with “也” or “还是”, gives the conclusion, e.g.,

body.zh: 即便 + 假设，（主语）+ 也／还是 + 结论
body.en: even if + (supposition), (subject) + still + (conclusion)

body.zh: 太晚了，即便你马上就去，到那儿银行也关门了。
body.py: Tài wǎn le, jíbiàn nǐ mǎshàng jiù qù, dào nàr yínháng yě guān mén le.
body.en: It's too late — even if you go right now, the bank will be closed when you get there.

body.zh: 这篇文章太难了，即便我再读一遍，还是读不懂。
body.py: Zhè piān wénzhāng tài nán le, jíbiàn wǒ zài dú yí biàn, háishi dú bu dǒng.
body.en: This article is too hard — even if I read it again, I still won't understand it.
Pair 即便 with 也 or 还是, not 就: ✓ 即便想赢，也赢不了; ✓ 即便说错了，也不用不好意思.

title.en: The usage of ……得住 and ……不住

body.zh: “……得住”用在动词后，做可能补语，表示牢固、稳当，也可以表示力量够得上或能持续较长时间，否定形式是“……不住”。例如：
body.py: “…… de zhù” yòng zài dòngcí hòu, zuò kěnéng bǔyǔ, biǎoshì láogù, wěndang, yě kěyǐ biǎoshì lìliang gòu de shàng huò néng chíxù jiào cháng shíjiān, fǒudìng xíngshì shì “…… bu zhù”. Lìrú:
body.en: “……得住” follows a verb as a potential complement, meaning firm and steady, strong enough, or able to last; its negative form is “……不住”, e.g.,

body.zh: 动词 + 得住（能）／不住（不能）
body.py: dòngcí + de zhù (néng) / bu zhù (bù néng)
body.en: verb + 得住 (can hold / last) / 不住 (can't)

body.zh: 这种台灯虽然比较贵，但是质量好，用得住。
body.py: Zhè zhǒng táidēng suīrán bǐjiào guì, dànshì zhìliàng hǎo, yòng de zhù.
body.en: This lamp is a bit pricey, but it's good quality — it'll last.

body.zh: 这么多东西，你拿得住拿不住？
body.py: Zhème duō dōngxi, nǐ ná de zhù ná bu zhù?
body.en: So many things — can you hold them all?

body.py: Wǒ lèi de dōu zhàn bu zhù le.
body.en: I'm so tired I can't stand up any more.
Negate inside the verb: 用不住, 拿不住 — never ✗ 不用住. 拿不住了 = “I can't hold on any longer” (so: 快帮帮我！).

body.zh: “要不然”意思是“如果不这样，否则”，用来引出与上文相反的情况并加以阐述。多用于口语，也可以说“要不”。例如：
body.en: “要不然” means “if not / otherwise”: it introduces what would happen in the opposite case. Mostly spoken; you can also say “要不”, e.g.,

body.zh: 建议／事实，要不然 + （不好的）结果
body.py: jiànyì / shìshí, yàobùrán + (bù hǎo de) jiéguǒ
body.en: advice / fact, otherwise + (bad) result

body.zh: 快点儿吧，要不然会迟到的。
body.py: Kuài diǎnr ba, yàobùrán huì chídào de.
body.en: Hurry up, or we'll be late.

body.zh: 我想他可能是病了，要不然他不会不来的。
body.py: Wǒ xiǎng tā kěnéng shì bìng le, yàobùrán tā bú huì bù lái de.
body.en: I think he must be ill — otherwise he wouldn't miss it.
要不然 starts the second clause, after the advice: ✓ 小票你得留好，要不然就不能退货了 — ✗ 要不然小票你得留好，…

body.zh: 昨天晚上，我的台灯突然坏了。
body.py: Zuótiān wǎnshang, wǒ de táidēng tūrán huài le.
body.en: Last night my desk lamp suddenly broke.

prompt.en: The car was driving along when…

answer.zh: 车开着开着，突然停了。
answer.en: The car was driving along when it suddenly stopped. (model answer)

prompt.zh: 昨天晚上我睡觉的时候，______。（突然）
prompt.py: Zuótiān wǎnshang wǒ shuì jiào de shíhou, ______. (tūrán)
prompt.en: Last night while I was asleep…

answer.zh: 昨天晚上我睡觉的时候，电话突然响了。
answer.en: Last night while I was asleep, the phone suddenly rang. (model answer)

prompt.zh: 他们一边走，一边聊，______。（突然）
prompt.en: They were walking and chatting when…

answer.zh: 他们一边走，一边聊，突然下起了大雨。
answer.en: They were walking and chatting when it suddenly started pouring. (model answer)

answer.zh: 听到这个消息，她突然哭了起来。
answer.en: Hearing the news, she suddenly burst into tears. (model answer)

prompt.en: …, it was a real surprise to me.

answer.zh: 他说下个月要回国，我觉得很突然。
answer.en: He said he's going home next month — that was really sudden. (model answer)

prompt.zh: 编故事。每人说一句话，连成一个故事。排在偶数的那个人必须使用“突然”。
prompt.en: Class activity: build a story one sentence each; every second person must use 突然.

answer.zh: 昨天我去超市买东西。突然，超市里的灯都灭了。大家都很害怕。突然，有人大声说：“别担心，马上就好！”
answer.py: Zuótiān wǒ qù chāoshì mǎi dōngxi. Tūrán, chāoshì li de dēng dōu miè le. Dàjiā dōu hěn hàipà. Tūrán, yǒu rén dàshēng shuō: “Bié dānxīn, mǎshàng jiù hǎo!”
answer.en: Yesterday I went shopping at the supermarket. Suddenly all the lights went out. Everyone was frightened. Suddenly someone shouted: “Don't worry, it'll be fixed in a moment!” (model answer)

instructions.zh: 一人根据情况对对方进行劝说，另一人用“即便”表明自己态度坚决。
instructions.en: One person tries to talk the other out of it; the other shows they won't budge, using “即便”.

lines.speaker: A
lines.zh: 这个洗衣机刚用一个星期就出毛病了，我要求退货。
lines.py: Zhège xǐyījī gāng yòng yí ge xīngqī jiù chū máobìng le, wǒ yāoqiú tuì huò.
lines.en: This washing machine broke after just one week — I want to return it.

lines.speaker: B
lines.py: Wǒ kěyǐ bāng nǐ huàn ge xīn de.
lines.en: I can exchange it for a new one for you.

lines.speaker: A
lines.zh: 即便可以换新的，我也要退。
lines.py: Jíbiàn kěyǐ huàn xīn de, wǒ yě yào tuì.
lines.en: Even if I can get a new one, I still want to return it.

prompt.zh: 我打算参加“中文之星”比赛。
prompt.py: Wǒ dǎsuan cānjiā “Zhōngwén zhī Xīng” bǐsài.
prompt.en: I plan to enter the “Chinese Star” competition.

answer.zh: A：比赛很难，你可能拿不到名次。B：即便拿不到名次，我也要参加。
answer.py: A: Bǐsài hěn nán, nǐ kěnéng ná bu dào míngcì. B: Jíbiàn ná bu dào míngcì, wǒ yě yào cānjiā.
answer.en: A: It's tough — you might not place. B: Even if I don't place, I'm entering. (model answer)

prompt.zh: 我要一个人去西藏旅行。
prompt.en: I'm going to travel to Tibet on my own.

answer.zh: A：一个人去太危险了。B：即便危险，我也要去。
answer.en: A: Going alone is too dangerous. B: Even if it's dangerous, I'm going. (model answer)

answer.zh: A：现在工作不好找啊。B：即便找不到新工作，我也要辞职。
answer.en: A: Jobs are hard to find right now. B: Even if I can't find a new one, I'm resigning. (model answer)

answer.zh: A：减肥很辛苦，你不能吃好吃的了。B：即便再辛苦，我还是要减。
answer.en: A: Dieting is hard — no more tasty food. B: However hard it is, I'm still doing it. (model answer)

prompt.zh: 这个手机坏了，我要求换个新的。
prompt.en: This phone is broken — I want a new one.

answer.zh: A：我们可以帮您免费修理。B：即便免费修理，我也要换个新的。
answer.en: A: We can repair it for free. B: Even if the repair is free, I want a new one. (model answer)

instructions.zh: 根据图片和关键词用“……得住”或“……不住”进行问答。
instructions.en: Ask and answer about each picture using “……得住” or “……不住”.

body.en: Example: a broken desk lamp lying on its side.

lines.speaker: A
lines.zh: 这种台灯质量不好，用不住。
lines.py: Zhè zhǒng táidēng zhìliàng bù hǎo, yòng bu zhù.
lines.en: This kind of lamp is poor quality — it won't last.

lines.speaker: B
lines.zh: 你觉得你的台灯用得住吗？
lines.py: Nǐ juéde nǐ de táidēng yòng de zhù ma?
lines.en: Do you think your lamp will last?

lines.speaker: A
lines.py: Wǒ de táidēng yòng de zhù.

items.picture: A hand clutching far too many things — pens, a ruler, keys — about to drop them.

answer.zh: A：东西太多了，我拿不住了！B：你拿得住拿不住？我帮你拿吧。
answer.py: A: Dōngxi tài duō le, wǒ ná bu zhù le! B: Nǐ ná de zhù ná bu zhù? Wǒ bāng nǐ ná ba.
answer.en: A: Too many things — I can't hold them! B: Can you manage? Let me take some. (model answer)

items.picture: A person leaning into a fierce wind, struggling to stay upright.

answer.zh: 风太大了，他快站不住了。
answer.py: Fēng tài dà le, tā kuài zhàn bu zhù le.
answer.en: The wind is so strong he can barely stay on his feet. (model answer)

items.picture: An old wooden wardrobe stuffed so full its doors won't stay shut.

answer.zh: 衣柜里的衣服太多了，门关不住了。
answer.py: Yīguì li de yīfu tài duō le, mén guān bu zhù le.
answer.en: There are too many clothes in the wardrobe — the doors won't stay shut. (model answer)

items.picture: Someone lifting a heavily overloaded plastic shopping bag.

answer.zh: 这个塑料袋装不住这么多东西。
answer.py: Zhège sùliàodài zhuāng bu zhù zhème duō dōngxi.
answer.en: This plastic bag can't hold so much. (model answer)

items.picture: A car speeding through a red light at a crossing with pedestrians.

answer.zh: 车开得太快了，到了红灯停不住了。
answer.py: Chē kāi de tài kuài le, dàole hóngdēng tíng bu zhù le.
answer.en: The car was going too fast and couldn't stop at the red light. (model answer)

instructions.zh: 大家根据图片陈述自己的情况，其他人作为朋友用“……，要不然……”进行叮嘱或规劝。说得越多越好。
instructions.en: One person describes their situation from a picture; the others, as friends, give advice using “……，要不然……”. The more the better.

answer.zh: 别玩儿游戏了，快去睡觉吧，要不然明天又起不来了。
answer.py: Bié wánr yóuxì le, kuài qù shuì jiào ba, yàobùrán míngtiān yòu qǐ bu lái le.
answer.en: Stop gaming and go to bed, otherwise you won't be able to get up tomorrow again. (model answer)

items.picture: A laptop and a cup of coffee next to an alarm clock late at night.

answer.zh: 早点儿休息吧，要不然身体会受不了的。
answer.py: Zǎo diǎnr xiūxi ba, yàobùrán shēntǐ huì shòu bu liǎo de.
answer.en: Get some rest early, otherwise your health won't take it. (model answer)

items.picture: A hand holding a lit cigarette.

answer.zh: 少抽点儿烟吧，要不然对身体不好。
answer.py: Shǎo chōu diǎnr yān ba, yàobùrán duì shēntǐ bù hǎo.
answer.en: Smoke less, otherwise it'll harm your health. (model answer)

items.picture: A hand holding lots of shopping bags.

answer.zh: 别再买了，要不然这个月的钱就不够花了。
answer.py: Bié zài mǎi le, yàobùrán zhège yuè de qián jiù bú gòu huā le.
answer.en: Stop buying, otherwise you won't have enough money for the month. (model answer)

instructions.zh: 在正确的句子或合适的答句前打✓，看看你语法学得怎么样。
instructions.en: Tick ✓ the right sentence or answer to check how well you have learned the grammar.

options.zh: 要是没有实力，即便想赢，也赢不了。
options.py: Yàoshi méiyǒu shílì, jíbiàn xiǎng yíng, yě yíng bu liǎo.

options.zh: 要是没有实力，即便想赢，就赢不了。
options.py: Yàoshi méiyǒu shílì, jíbiàn xiǎng yíng, jiù yíng bu liǎo.

questions.explain: 即便 pairs with 也 (or 还是), not 就. (grammar note 2)

options.zh: 我担心这种手机用不住。
options.py: Wǒ dānxīn zhè zhǒng shǒujī yòng bu zhù.

options.zh: 我担心这种手机不用住。
options.py: Wǒ dānxīn zhè zhǒng shǒujī bú yòng zhù.

questions.explain: The negative goes between verb and complement: 用不住. (grammar note 3)

options.zh: 学语言得多听多说，即便说错了，就不用不好意思。
options.py: Xué yǔyán děi duō tīng duō shuō, jíbiàn shuōcuò le, jiù búyòng bù hǎoyìsi.

options.zh: 学语言得多听多说，即便说错了，也不用不好意思。
options.py: Xué yǔyán děi duō tīng duō shuō, jíbiàn shuōcuò le, yě búyòng bù hǎoyìsi.
Kuài bāngbang wǒ, wǒ ná bu zhù le!
Kuài bāngbang wǒ, wǒ ná de zhù le!

questions.explain: You ask for help because you can't hold it: 拿不住. (grammar note 3)

options.zh: 小票你得留好，要不然就不能退货了。
options.py: Xiǎopiào nǐ děi liúhǎo, yàobùrán jiù bù néng tuì huò le.

options.zh: 要不然小票你得留好，就不能退货了。
options.py: Yàoburán xiǎopiào nǐ děi liúhǎo, jiù bù néng tuì huò le.

questions.explain: 要不然 comes after the advice and introduces what happens otherwise. (grammar note 4)

quiz.answer_note: Book's scoring: all right — 太棒了！. Missed Q5 — review 要不然 (note 4). Missed Q1 or Q3 — review 即便 (note 2). Missed Q2 or Q4 — review ……得住/……不住 (note 3).
